# add reload function

Add `reload`, which re-sources the current shell's rc file:

```
$ reload
# if zsh: source ~/.zshrc, else: source ~/.bash_profile
```

After `self-update` or an edit to the libraries the new definitions are only picked up by new shells; `reload` would apply them in place. It has to be a function (a script cannot `source` into the caller).
